card.title: Sony Dualshock 4 Not Charging

claims.statement: DualShock 4 not charging is more often the charging port board than the battery; check the battery connector for shorts and current draw on a bench PSU, then shorts around the PMIC.

procedure: Check battery connector draw/shorts on bench PSU.
Trace shorts to PMIC caps or PMIC.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
